opportunities.name: Supplier quote currency comparison and procurement email
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes (amount A in currency X, amount B in currency Y) to USD on xe.com, look up the current local time in the supplier's city on timeanddate, then draft an email to procurement saying which quote is cheaper.
steps: Open the xe.com currency converter (Personal > Currency converter)
Set the source currency to quote 1's currency and enter amount 1; record the USD value
Change the source currency to quote 2's currency (search the currency dropdown) and enter amount 2; record the USD value
Decide which quote is cheaper in USD
Open timeanddate World Clock, search for the supplier city and select it; record the local time and zone
Open mail compose: To = procurement@example.com, Subject = 'Quotes: <item>'
Body = '<amt1> <cur1> = <usd1> USD, <amt2> <cur2> = <usd2> USD, cheaper: <cur>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: item=CNC enclosures; 12500 EUR (13,993.90 USD) vs 1950000 JPY (12,315.30 USD); city=Osaka
item=Shipping boxes; 8200 GBP (10,862.40 USD) vs 780000 INR (8,209.32 USD); city=Pune
3rd round, not finished and interrupted by other tasks: 64000 INR (672.67 USD) vs 14500 CNY (2,166.39 USD); no email seen

opportunities.name: Company account brief (SEC 10-K + Wikipedia) email
opportunities.description: For a ticker, find the company's latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR full-text search, get HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, and email an account brief to the account owner.
steps: On EDGAR full-text search, clear the company field, type the ticker and pick the matching company from the autocomplete
Expand the 'Form' filter and select '10-K Annual report'; record the most recent Filed date
On Wikipedia, search for the company name and open its article; record HQ, employees and CEO from the infobox
Open mail compose: To = dana@example.com, Subject = 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Body = '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake; HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20
DDOG / Datadog; HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18
HUBS / HubSpot; only the EDGAR 10-K filter step was seen, no Wikipedia lookup or email

opportunities.name: Cross-office sync planning email (time difference + holidays)
opportunities.description: Get the time difference between two office cities with the timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up public holidays for the second city's country in a given month, and email ops which dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate Time Zones > Time Zone Converter (close the 'restore' prompt if it appears)
Add city 1 from the location search, then add city 2; record the offset
Open Calendar > Holidays, pick the country of city 2 and go to its holidays for the year
Filter to or scroll to the target month and note the gazetted/public holidays
Open mail compose: To = ops@example.com, Subject = 'Sync: <city1> / <city2>, <Month>'
Body = '<city2> is <offset> ahead from <city1>. Avoid: <dates>.'
Send or discard the draft

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October; +12h30; avoid Oct 2 and Oct 20
New York / Berlin, Germany, December; +6h; avoid Dec 25 and Dec 26
